visual.general_description: Four-panel clinical figure (A to D) with three color photographs (scalp hair, skin, front teeth) and a panoramic dental radiograph.

visual.general_description: Pedigree diagram of a five-generation family with the proband and suspected affected members marked.
visual.detailed_description: Pedigree of blue-outlined squares and circles on white, with printed member codes beneath each symbol, sibship and descent lines, diagonal strikes through many symbols, three black-filled symbols and a small arrow marking the proband symbol in the lowest generation.

panels.general_description: Family pedigree chart in five generations with the proband marked by an arrow and three filled symbols.
panels.detailed_description: Black-line pedigree on a white background with blue-outlined symbols, five generation rows with printed member codes under each symbol. Squares and circles are used, and a number of symbols are crossed by a diagonal line. Three symbols are filled black: one in the third generation, one in the fourth generation and one in the fifth generation, the last marked by a small arrow with a letter beside it at its lower left. A double horizontal line joins one pair of symbols in the third generation. Horizontal sibship lines and vertical descent lines connect the generations. No scale or other text.

evidence.quote: Six members of his extended family were selected to investigate the mutation in the EDA gene and its inheritance.

pixel_observations: Squares and circles with printed generation-member codes; several symbols crossed by a diagonal line.
Three filled black symbols, matching the caption statement that filled symbols are suspected affected members.
A small arrow with a letter next to one filled symbol in the fifth generation, matching the caption statement that the proband is marked with an arrow.
Double horizontal line between one pair of third-generation symbols.

caption_claims.value: Caption states that the proband is marked with an arrow and filled symbols are suspected affected family members.

evidence.quote: the proband (V-6) is marked with an arrow; filled symbols represent the suspected affected family members according to clinical investigations

clinical_significance.statement: The authors present the pedigree of the analyzed family with the proband and suspected affected members indicated.

evidence.quote: pedigree of the family analyzed

limitations: Symbol meanings for crossed lines and the double horizontal line are not defined in the caption.
The small arrow near the proband symbol is described, but its exact endpoint was not recorded as a diagram relation.
Member codes are printed under symbols; they are not transcribed here beyond those named in the caption and text.

visual.general_description: Two gel electrophoresis images of PCR-amplified EDA exons from the proband and relatives.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A (top) shows a dark grey gel with lanes for exons 1, 3 and 5 and a marker lane M. Panel B (bottom) shows a black-background gel with labelled lanes for EDA exons 4, 6, 7, 8, 9 and EDAR exon 12 for six samples in two rows. Panel letters are not printed on the image; the A and B assignment follows the caption order.

panels.general_description: Gel electrophoresis image with three sets of lanes labelled for EDA exon 1, exon 3 and exon 5.
panels.detailed_description: Dark grey agarose gel photograph with white lane labels along the top. A marker lane labelled M with several ladder bands is at the far left. The first set has six sample lanes with the exon label Exon 1 below; bands are visible in four lanes, and no band is visible in two lanes. The second set has six lanes with the label Exon 3 below, each with one band near the bottom of the gel. A seventh lane at the far right is labelled with exon 5 printed as Exon5 and shows only a very faint band. Bright smears sit near the wells in several lanes.

imaging_modalities.visual_cue: Fluorescent bands on a dark gel photograph

evidence.quote: Polymerase chain reaction (PCR) fragments of 240-732bp

pixel_observations: Marker lane M with multiple ladder bands.
Exon 1 set: visible bands in four of the six lanes and no visible band in two lanes.
Exon 3 set: one band visible in each of six lanes.
Exon5 label with one lane showing only a very faint band.
White lane labels with member codes; no names or dates.

evidence.quote: A) electrophoresis result of the amplified regions for EDA gene Exon 1,3 and 5

clinical_significance.statement: The authors state all participants showed clear bands for each exon in the PCR.

evidence.quote: All participants showed clear bands for each exon in the polymerase chain reaction (Figure 3).

limitations: Band sizes are not read; the ladder has no printed sizes in this panel.

Two lanes in the exon 1 set show no visible band and exon 5 shows only one lane with a faint band, which does not visibly match the text statement of clear bands for every exon for all participants; recorded as an ambiguity, not resolved.

panels.general_description: Black-background gel photograph with six groups of lanes for EDA exons 4, 6, 7, 8, 9 and EDAR exon 12.
panels.detailed_description: Black background with white rotated lane labels EDA Exon 4, EDA Exon 6, EDA Exon 7, EDA Exon 8, EDA Exon 9 and EDAR Exon 12 for each of six samples arranged in two rows of three. Each sample group has a printed member code under a horizontal line. Each lane shows a single white band, and a marker lane labelled Hyperladder IV with printed size labels sits at the left of each row.

evidence.quote: Polymerase chain reaction (PCR) fragments of 240-732bp
